name: strings
doc:
strings functions written in Zell (the rest of strings are runtime
externs, std/strings/strings_extern.zl; Builder is in builder.zl).

items.name: Bytes
items.signature: func Bytes(s string) []byte
items.doc: Bytes returns the UTF-8 bytes of s.
items.summary: Bytes returns the UTF-8 bytes of s.

items.name: Compare
items.signature: func Compare(a string, b string) int
items.doc: Compare returns -1, 0 or 1 comparing a and b bytewise.
items.summary: Compare returns -1, 0 or 1 comparing a and b bytewise.

items.name: Contains
items.signature: func Contains(s string, substr string) bool
items.doc: Contains reports whether substr is within s.
items.summary: Contains reports whether substr is within s.

items.name: ContainsAny
items.signature: func ContainsAny(s string, chars string) bool
items.doc: ContainsAny reports whether s contains any of the runes of chars.
items.summary: ContainsAny reports whether s contains any of the runes of chars.

items.name: Count
items.signature: func Count(s string, substr string) int
items.doc: Count returns the number of non-overlapping instances of substr in s.
items.summary: Count returns the number of non-overlapping instances of substr in s.

items.name: EqualFold
items.signature: func EqualFold(s string, t string) bool
items.doc: EqualFold reports whether s and t are equal under simple Unicode case folding.
items.summary: EqualFold reports whether s and t are equal under simple Unicode case folding.

items.name: Fields
items.signature: func Fields(s string) []string
items.doc: Fields splits s around runs of white space.
items.summary: Fields splits s around runs of white space.

items.name: FromBytes
items.signature: func FromBytes(b []byte) string
items.doc: FromBytes returns the string with bytes b.
items.summary: FromBytes returns the string with bytes b.

items.name: FromRunes
items.signature: func FromRunes(runes []char) string
items.doc: FromRunes encodes runes as a UTF-8 string.
items.summary: FromRunes encodes runes as a UTF-8 string.

items.name: HasPrefix
items.signature: func HasPrefix(s string, prefix string) bool
items.doc: HasPrefix reports whether s begins with prefix.
items.summary: HasPrefix reports whether s begins with prefix.

items.name: HasSuffix
items.signature: func HasSuffix(s string, suffix string) bool
items.doc: HasSuffix reports whether s ends with suffix.
items.summary: HasSuffix reports whether s ends with suffix.

items.name: Index
items.signature: func Index(s string, substr string) int
items.doc: Index returns the byte index of the first instance of substr in s, or -1.
items.summary: Index returns the byte index of the first instance of substr in s, or -1.

items.name: IndexAny
items.signature: func IndexAny(s string, chars string) int
items.doc:
IndexAny returns the byte index of the first rune of s that is any of
the runes of chars, or -1 when there is none (or chars is empty).
items.summary: IndexAny returns the byte index of the first rune of s that is any of the runes of chars, or -1 when there is none (or chars is empty).

items.name: Join
items.signature: func Join(elems []string, sep string) string
items.doc: Join concatenates elems, placing sep between them.
items.summary: Join concatenates elems, placing sep between them.

items.name: LastIndex
items.signature: func LastIndex(s string, substr string) int
items.doc: LastIndex returns the byte index of the last instance of substr in s, or -1.
items.summary: LastIndex returns the byte index of the last instance of substr in s, or -1.

items.name: PadLeft
items.signature: func PadLeft(s string, width int, pad string) string
items.doc: PadLeft prepends pad until s is width characters wide.
items.summary: PadLeft prepends pad until s is width characters wide.

items.name: PadRight
items.signature: func PadRight(s string, width int, pad string) string
items.doc: PadRight appends pad until s is width characters wide.
items.summary: PadRight appends pad until s is width characters wide.

items.name: Repeat
items.signature: func Repeat(s string, count int) string
items.doc: Repeat returns count copies of s.
items.summary: Repeat returns count copies of s.

items.name: Replace
items.signature: func Replace(s string, old string, repl string) string
items.doc: Replace returns a copy of s with every non-overlapping instance of old replaced by repl.
items.summary: Replace returns a copy of s with every non-overlapping instance of old replaced by repl.

items.name: ReplaceAll
items.signature: func ReplaceAll(s string, old string, repl string) string
items.doc:
ReplaceAll returns a copy of s with every non-overlapping instance of
old replaced by repl; the same as Replace, which also replaces every
instance (Go's strings.ReplaceAll).
items.summary: ReplaceAll returns a copy of s with every non-overlapping instance of old replaced by repl; the same as Replace, which also replaces every instance (Go's strings.ReplaceAll).

items.name: Reverse
items.signature: func Reverse(s string) string
items.doc: Reverse returns s with its characters in reverse order.
items.summary: Reverse returns s with its characters in reverse order.

items.name: Runes
items.signature: func Runes(s string) []char
items.doc: Runes returns the Unicode code points of s.
items.summary: Runes returns the Unicode code points of s.

items.name: Split
items.signature: func Split(s string, sep string) []string
items.doc: Split slices s into all substrings separated by sep. An empty sep splits after each UTF-8 sequence.
items.summary: Split slices s into all substrings separated by sep.

examples.name: ExampleSplit_empty
examples.code:
// An empty separator splits after each UTF-8 sequence.
println(strings.Split("héllo", ""))

items.name: SplitN
items.signature: func SplitN(s string, sep string, n int) []string
items.doc: SplitN splits s around sep into at most n substrings (n < 0: all).
items.summary: SplitN splits s around sep into at most n substrings (n < 0: all).

items.name: Title
items.signature: func Title(s string) string
items.doc: Title returns s with the first letter of each word in upper case.
items.summary: Title returns s with the first letter of each word in upper case.

items.name: ToFloat
items.signature: func ToFloat(s string) float!
items.doc: ToFloat parses s as a floating-point number.
items.summary: ToFloat parses s as a floating-point number.

items.name: ToInt
items.signature: func ToInt(s string) int!
items.doc: ToInt parses s as a decimal integer (optional sign).
items.summary: ToInt parses s as a decimal integer (optional sign).

examples.name: ExampleToInt
examples.code:
var n = try strings.ToInt("-42") else 0
var bad = try strings.ToInt("4x2") else -1
println(n, bad)

items.name: ToLower
items.signature: func ToLower(s string) string
items.doc: ToLower returns s with all Unicode letters mapped to lower case.
items.summary: ToLower returns s with all Unicode letters mapped to lower case.

items.name: ToUpper
items.signature: func ToUpper(s string) string
items.doc: ToUpper returns s with all Unicode letters mapped to upper case.
items.summary: ToUpper returns s with all Unicode letters mapped to upper case.

items.name: Trim
items.signature: func Trim(s string) string
items.doc: Trim returns s without leading and trailing white space.
items.summary: Trim returns s without leading and trailing white space.

items.name: TrimLeft
items.signature: func TrimLeft(s string, cutset string) string
items.doc: TrimLeft returns s with all leading characters contained in cutset removed.
items.summary: TrimLeft returns s with all leading characters contained in cutset removed.

items.name: TrimPrefix
items.signature: func TrimPrefix(s string, prefix string) string
items.doc: TrimPrefix returns s without the leading prefix, if present.
items.summary: TrimPrefix returns s without the leading prefix, if present.

items.name: TrimRight
items.signature: func TrimRight(s string, cutset string) string
items.doc: TrimRight returns s with all trailing characters contained in cutset removed.
items.summary: TrimRight returns s with all trailing characters contained in cutset removed.

items.name: TrimSuffix
items.signature: func TrimSuffix(s string, suffix string) string
items.doc: TrimSuffix returns s without the trailing suffix, if present.
items.summary: TrimSuffix returns s without the trailing suffix, if present.

items.name: Builder
items.signature: struct Builder
items.doc:
strings.Builder: accumulates text in one growing byte buffer (capacity
doubles, so n writes cost O(n) copying); String() builds the string once.
items.summary: strings.Builder: accumulates text in one growing byte buffer (capacity doubles, so n writes cost O(n) copying); String() builds the string once.

members.name: WriteString
members.doc: WriteString appends s (the Go name of Write).
members.summary: WriteString appends s (the Go name of Write).

members.name: WriteRune
members.doc:
WriteRune appends the UTF-8 encoding of r; an invalid code point
(a surrogate or above U+10FFFF) is written as U+FFFD.
members.summary: WriteRune appends the UTF-8 encoding of r; an invalid code point (a surrogate or above U+10FFFF) is written as U+FFFD.

examples.name: ExampleBuilder
